replication.target_description: Study 1, categorical nostalgia versus control song condition predicting mixed valence by minimum function (MIN), rather than mixed-emotion incidence predicting nostalgia.

n.sample_role: Participants (clusters); 2,234 song-level observations in the final paired-song analysis.
n.exclusions: 14 removed for improper responses; 172 without appropriately matched control songs excluded. Only complete nostalgia/control song pairs retained.

notes: Known test mismatch; mixed valence operationalization and predictor/outcome roles differ. MIN selected because paper uses it for subsequent interaction models.
